findings.passage: I am grateful for the continued support of the NRA and gun owners throughout the New River Valley,” said Delegate Jason Ballard. “As a Veteran and avid hunter, I understand the importance of defending our right to bear arms.
findings.note: Quoted in his own campaign release, printed by PCPatriot, on receiving the NRA endorsement. He speaks of defending the right to bear arms.

findings.passage: I have always been – and will continue to be – the Second Amendment’s strongest advocate in Richmond.
findings.note: Same release. He calls himself the strongest advocate for the Second Amendment in the legislature.

findings.passage: The law, which takes effect in July, prohibits the purchase, import, or sale of common rifles such as the AR-15.
findings.note: From his column, signed as Delegate for the 42nd District, on HB 217 (assault firearms ban), which the Governor signed. He describes what the law does.

findings.passage: This act by Governor Spanberger sets the stage for millions more to be spent by the Commonwealth to defend a law that may be found unconstitutional.
findings.note: Same column. He says the signed assault firearms ban may be found unconstitutional and will cost the state to defend.

findings.passage: The U.S Supreme Court has ruled in the Bruen and Heller cases that firearms in common use for lawful purposes are protected by the Second Amendment.
findings.note: Same column. He cites Supreme Court cases as the legal basis against the ban.
